extension.description:
The same ScreenMazer screensaver as "ScreenMazer (OpenGL)", built for 32-bit Android (armeabi-v7a), as on many Fire TV sticks, Google TV boxes and the Chromecast with Google TV. Install this one if your Android or Google TV Kodi is a 32-bit app; install "ScreenMazer (OpenGL)" on 64-bit Android and macOS.
A maze is drawn cell by cell around a block showing the current time, then the path from the entrance to the exit is traced in a second colour, and the screen fades out for the next maze. Cell size, build and solve times, colours, and the clock's size, position and 12/24-hour format are in the add-on settings. Very small cells mean many more cells to animate; raise the cell size if the motion stutters on a small box.
extension.disclaimer: This is a native add-on: it is built per platform and Kodi version (this one: Kodi 21 Omega, 32-bit ARM Android). It needs OpenGL ES 2.0. ScreenMazer was created by Alex Beals (https://github.com/dado3212/ScreenMazer); this is a C++ port of its maze generator and animation with a new renderer and Kodi settings.
